== Pets == <tabber> Sand Soldier= {{Anchor|Sand Soldier}} {{Infobox/Pet |name = Sand Soldiers |image = File:Arise!.png |render = {{GalleryHelper |Azir Arise! Render.png¦Arise! |Azir Emperor's Divide Render.png¦Emperor's Divide }} |range = 375 / {{tt|425|Damage range}} |sight = <!--300 sight radius?--> |damage = {{as|{{pp|0;5;10;15;20;25;30;35;40;45|1;10;11;12;13;14;15;16;17;18|formula=0 at level 1, then +5 per level starting at level 10}} (+ {{ap|50 to 110}})|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35 to 55}}% AP)}} |damagetype = magic |movespeed = |gold = |exp = |control = Attacks whenever '''Azir''' inputs an attack command on a target near them. |targeting = {{tip|Minion}} ({{tip|untargetable}}) |onhit = ''Sand Soldiers' '' attacks are mitigated by {{tip|block}} or {{tip|dodge}}, likewise while '''Azir''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}. |spelleffects = ''Sand Soldiers' '' attacks apply [[spell effects]] as {{tip|area damage}}. |abilities = ;Spear Attack ''Sand Soldiers'' will strike their spear in a line in the target's direction, dealing damage to all enemies within the area. Their attack passes through by 50 units. There is a brief delay between the command and the attack occurring.
;Lifetime ''Sand Soldiers'' expire twice as fast while within range of a nearby enemy {{tip|turret}}, and expires instantly when '''Azir''' is too far away.
;Imperative Whenever '''Azir''' declares an attack on a target within 375 units of one of his ''Sand Soldiers'', he instead commands all ''Sand Soldiers'' in range to attack. }} |-| Sun Disc= {{Anchor|Sun Disc}} {{Infobox/Pet |name = Sun Disc |image = File:Shurima's Legacy.png |render = {{GalleryHelper |Azir Shurima's Legacy Render.png¦Sun Disc |Azir Disk of the Sun Render.png¦Spawn }} |attributes = |gold = 50 |exp = 0 |hp = {{pp|1750 to 3000 for 6|0 to 5|type=enemy champions in the game|color=health}} (always 3000 in matchmade games) |damage = {{pp|230 to 410 for 13|1;7 to 18|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}} |damagetype = Magic |range = 750 |armor = {{pp|30 to 90 for 13|1;7 to 18|color=armor}} |magicresist = {{pp|30 to 90 for 13|1;7 to 18|color=magic resistance}} |ccresist = {{tip|cc-immune|Immune to crowd control}} except {{tip|stasis}} |attackspeed = {{as|{{fd|0.833}}|attack speed}} |movespeed = |control = {{tip|Turret}} (static) |targeting = [[Structure]] |spelleffects = The ''Sun Disc's'' basic attacks apply [[spell effects]] as {{tip|spell damage}}. |onhit = The ''Sun Disc's'' attacks cannot be mitigated by {{tip|block}} and {{tip|dodge}}. |abilities = ;Dodge Piercing The ''Sun Disc's'' attacks cannot be evaded except by effects with {{tip|homing projectile destruction}}.
;Warden's Eye The ''Sun Disc'' gains {{tip|true sight}}; it can see {{tip|stealth|stealthed}} units within a 1000 radius of it.
;Deserter If '''Azir''' is dead or not within approximately 2000 units, the ''Sun Disc's'' {{sti|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|magic resistance}}}} is reduced by 100.
===General=== * The ''Sun Disc'' can be targeted by {{ri|Demolish}}. * The ''Sun Disc's'' damage applies spell effects. }} </tabber>

==Patch history== {{Patch box|Azir}}
==Trivia==
* Azir is the first champion to have his first ability point restricted to a single one ({{ai|Arise!|Azir}}) since it's required for the other two ({{ai|Conquering Sands|Azir}} and {{ai|Shifting Sands|Azir}}) to function. ** He is also the second champion to be unable to rank up a basic ability at Level 1, the first being {{ci|Zilean}}. * {{ai|Shurima's Legacy|Azir}} may be referencing the Egyptian solar disc god {{w|Aten}}<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://boards.na.leagueoflegends.com/en/c/gameplay-balance/9f9inmau-azir-qa-art-sound?comment=00030001 Azir art discussion 1]</ref> (depicted as a sphere emanating rays of light each ending with a hand) and titular god of the short-lived monotheistic religion imposed by Pharaoh {{w|Akhenaten}}. His son {{w|Tutankhamun}} later restored the polytheistic religion. * Azir's dance references [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LeiFF0gvqcc Remember The Time] by {{w|Michael Jackson}}. ** A side-by-side comparison can be seen [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mg9cRCTUJKg here]. ** If Azir {{ai|Arise!|Azir|summons}} Sand Soldiers and then dances, they will follow him and dance all in sync. *** His soldiers will keep dance in Azir's stead while if the player types '/dance' while Azir is {{si|Recall|recalling}}. *** If enemies cannot see Azir while he dances, his soldiers will not appear to dance to them.
